          Definition. affinoid field [#]

            An affinoid field is a complete Huber pair where is either a nonarchimedean field or a discrete field, and is an open and bounded valuation subring.

                    Definition. sheafy [#]

                      A Huber pair is called sheafy if is a sheaf of topological rings. For any sheafy Huber pair, is automatically a subsheaf of topological rings.

                      Definition. strongly Noetherian [#]

                        A Huber pair is strongly Noetherian if is Noetherian.

                        Definition. stably uniform [#]

                          A Huber pair is stably uniform if is uniform for any rational subset .
